results.title: Arne Goes to Space
results.overview: Two small-town brothers are visited by an alien. Having crash-landed in the forests of Norrbotten, the visitor is named Roland. The brothers, Arne and Stefan, teach him everything important about life on Earth, including moonshine, hunting, and the mystery of love.

results.title: Goody Goody
results.overview: During a prolonged home birth trapped by a raging blizzard, expecting parents and their midwife begin to suspect something sinister is lurking nearby as labor complications escalate and their sense of safety unravels.

results.title: The Only Living Pickpocket in New York
results.original_title: The Only Living Pickpocket in New York
results.overview: Harry Lehman is an aging pickpocket who plies his trade with ever-diminishing returns in a drastically changed New York. Wallets stuffed with cash have been replaced by easily cancelled credit cards, and Harry struggles to make ends meet as he cares for his disabled wife, Rosie. When he unwittingly purloins and fences a valuable USB stick, Harry finds himself in a race against time to return the loot or face the rage of a vengeful crime family.

results.title: Clean Hands
results.overview: Based on a true story, a veteran narcotics officer turned recovery advocate and his daughter, who struggles with addiction, confront the American drug crisis from opposing sides of the law while navigating their complicated family bond.

results.title: The Passenger Andrzej Munk
results.overview: The documentary dedicated to Andrzej Munk, a leading creator of the Polish Film School, was created based on unique archival materials. They made up a story about a man immersed in history, his artistic evolution and the emotions accompanying this process.

results.title: LOOT: A Story of Crime and Redemption
results.original_title: LOOT: A Story of Crime and Redemption
results.overview: A daring look at the underbelly of the global art market, LOOT exposes the criminal network that used child soldiers to violently raid Cambodian temples then delivered blood antiquities to the homes of billionaires and elite western museums.

results.title: ...And Out Comes the Wolf
results.overview: Set against the East Bay punk music scene in the mid 1990s, a story of grit and dreams in a world of violence and desperation.

results.title: Mother's Day
results.overview: In a tiny Indigenous Mexican town where everyone is family, a secret pregnancy tests the forbidden love between two cousins. During the vibrant Mother’s Day festival, a public dance becomes a bold act of defiance that will change their lives forever.

results.title: 36 Hour Walk
results.overview: A college student attempts to walk from his dorm room in midtown Manhattan to the end of Long Island in 36 hours. Legyaan Thapa directs “36 Hour Walk,” a personal documentary of a half-hearted journey built with wry, self-deprecating commentary. Vowing not to eat or sleep for a day and a half, the man sets off on his trip. For what reason? He figures he’ll discover that along the way. But soon, he’s hit with setbacks, poor planning, frustration, boredom, and physical pain. The hours wear on, exhaustion sets in, and the challenge reaches its conclusion. It’s an entertaining ode to lofty pursuits and half-assed follow through, built with shaky, lo-fi visuals and an affably lackadaisical attitude.

results.title: Brimstone Terrace
results.overview: When a depressed public defender ends his own life, he is sentenced to an eternity in Hell. However, after Satan takes notice of his skills, he is offered an afterlife-changing deal that may not fall in line with his own values.

results.title: Trust Me, I'm a Doctor
results.overview: The life of Dr. Sandeep Kapoor was turned upside down when he's implicated in the wrongful death trial of one-time Playboy centerfold Anna Nicole Smith.

results.title: Radon’s Daughters
results.overview: The fates of two New Mexican families collide at a Dia de los Muertos celebration in a uranium-tainted church.

results.title: Midnight Dreamers
results.overview: In a post-dystopian world, two brothers are chased by a relentless hunter after the oldest abandons his labor camp post to seek a refugee haven in order to save his younger brother’s future.

results.title: AWM (Agney Weds Minal)
results.overview: Inspired by real-life stories and the lives of real couples, AWM takes you on an emotional journey of love, relationships, courage, dreams and the choices that shape our lives.

results.title: DreamQuil
results.overview: In a near future where poor air quality forces people into virtual lives, a dissatisfied mother joins a digital wellness retreat, only to return home and discover that a robotic replacement has taken her place, leading to a sinister mystery.

results.title: Småstadsliv - mellan himmel och körtburkar
results.overview: A feature film by the comedy group Småstadsliv, featuring recurring personalities from their universe. The plot revolves around hilarious and zany events—imbued with true small-town spirit and featuring colorful characters—including the debut of the character Sari as a psychopath.

results.title: Prahaar: The Untold Story of Ujjwal Nikam
results.original_title: प्रहार: दी अनटोल्ड स्टोरी ऑफ़ उज्ज्वल निकम
results.overview: Public prosecutor Ujjwal Nikam takes on one of the most high-profile criminal cases in India’s history, leading the prosecution in the trial of Ajmal Kasab following the 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks. As he battles to uncover the truth and secure justice, Nikam must confront the immense personal and professional burden of a case that will define his legacy.

results.title: 2 Lizards
results.overview: Two lizards are grappling with the reality of the first wave of the COVID-19 pandemic in New York.

results.title: The Shrew of Destiny
results.overview: Shrews are small, lovely and always hungry mammals… which Happen to have some epic adventures! When dark shadow is cast upon the Valley of Shrews an old prophecy is remembered: the Great Enemy, destroyer of all life in the forest will bring doom to all shrews. But there is also an optimistic part of the legend – the shrew of destiny will come to aid its tribe in the darkest hour. But what if the chosen one turns out to be the smallest, weakest and honestly not-so-bright shrew?
